Jokshan's sons were Sheba and Dedan (Genesis 25:3). Isaac and Rebekah had twin sons, Esau and Jacob, who was renamed Israel; Esau's line became the Edomites (Genesis 36). Jacob's twelve sons were Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Dan, Naphtali, Gad, Asher, Issachar, Zebulun, Joseph, and Benjamin, who became the heads of the twelve tribes of Israel.
